discovery.sql: SELECT toString(tweet_id) AS id, author_handle, text FROM twitter.tweets WHERE bucket_date >= '2026-09-20' AND bucket_date <= '2026-10-15' AND hasToken(search_text_lc, 'attribution') AND hasAnyTokens(search_text_lc, ['mattr','matryoshka']) AND NOT startsWith(text, 'RT @') ORDER BY tweet_id DESC, version DESC LIMIT 1 BY tweet_id LIMIT 10
discovery.note: Public author posts used for discovery; scientific claims checked against primary papers. Credentials and raw social text not stored in repository.
